svg.text: Top view, the Uno's USB end on the LEFT, digital headers at the top. Hole = ROW/COL.

g.title: G and B joined by the shield's GND traces (Evan metered 2026-10-20: beep)

line.title: w1: L3/7 to L3/9 VMOT to the VBAT strip, insulated, hops over L3/8
w2: L3/8 to B/8 TB6612 GND to the star rail, hops over P3/8 and P4/8
w3: L3/2 to V/0 TB6612 VCC to the Uno 5V - ROUTE: left along row L3, then up column 0 (never under the carrier)
w4: P4/7 to P3/-1 +5V2 to JP1's bottom pin - ROUTE: left along row P4 under the J1 pins, then up to P3/-1
w5: B/2 to P3/-2 servo GND to the star - ROUTE: left along row B, then up to P3/-2

svg.text: Power / analog headers below this edge
direct to Uno D2: encoder yellow (A) male Dupont pin on the cable end, straight into the D2 socket
direct to Uno D3: encoder white (B) male Dupont pin on the cable end, straight into the D3 socket
off-board C1 (470 uF on the carrier): +->TB.VMOT, -->TB.GND2 + lead (no stripe) to the VMOT pin tip, - lead (stripe side) to the GND pin tip next to it, at the right end of the carrier's
off-board C2 (0.1 uF on the carrier): a->TB.VMOT, b->TB.GND2 Same two pin tips as C1; no polarity.
join TB.PWMA <-> TB.PWMB carrier-top wire bridge (logic)
join TB.AIN2 <-> TB.BIN2 carrier-top wire bridge (logic)
join TB.AIN1 <-> TB.BIN1 carrier-top wire bridge (logic)
join TB.AO1 <-> TB.BO1 carrier-top wire bridge, 22 AWG (motor current)
join TB.AO2 <-> TB.BO2 carrier-top wire bridge, 22 AWG (motor current)
